About

The designer behind the pixels

I'm a B.Tech Information Technology graduate who fell hard for visual design — and never looked back. By trade I write code; by instinct I reach for colour palettes, grids and type.

My work lives at the intersection of brand storytelling and everyday scroll-stopping design — from moody automotive posters to warm café promotions and festival greetings that feel personal, not templated.

I care about the details most people skim past: kerning, contrast, the exact shade of a shadow. That's what makes a design feel finished instead of just "done."
